title: Hidden Musicality in Chinese Xiangsheng: A Response to the Call for Interdisciplinary Research in Studying Speech and Song

publication.publisher_or_container: Humanities and Social Sciences Communications, 7 (article 38), Palgrave Macmillan

verification.verification_notes: Peer-reviewed open-access article; abstract and bibliographic details inspected. Demonstrates that xiangsheng speech carries patterned rhythm and sound features central to its comic effect.

limitations: Chinese-language wordplay and prosody are assessed through an English-language scholarly analysis; original performance not inspected.

copyright.notes: Open-access peer-reviewed article; citation and paraphrase only.
